authority.rule: Retain historical artifacts and their original strict scores. A versioned supported-language migration can be justified by independent source-level semantics; a candidate output or observed failure alone cannot justify it.

reasoning: The historical regression explicitly places this case among missing values, but offers no external statement that the title is unfinished. The ellipsis occurs inside a nonempty quoted title operand.

C4 protects quotations and has an explicit title recognizer that owns the entire quoted operand. Its comment forbids interpreting interior content as numeric or subject syntax. V5's written contract generalizes this: quoted bibliographic owners consume their complete operands and interior keywords cannot create filters.

The frozen V5 operand scanner detects placeholder syntax immediately after the external field cue, before any opening quote. Its declared contract says quoted text stays literal. V5's supplied-state placeholder check applies outside(c.source_text), preserving quoted punctuation. These are independent grammar rules supporting literal treatment, not a response to V6 predictions.

Treating punctuation as a hidden placeholder only inside this particular title would weaken quoting as a stable literal boundary. Preserve the quote boundary and require an external incompleteness cue to request clarification.
boundaries: Unquoted terminal markers such as titled ... and titled [to be supplied] remain INCOMPLETE.
An explicit external statement that the title operand is missing, partial, or unresolved remains subject to the mandatory missing/relationship rules.
This does not license a broad search by silently discarding an unresolved title. The complete quoted title predicate and independent author predicate must both survive.
decisions.compatibility_effect: Changes typed decision and permits the literal title/author conjunction where the historical assertion blocked execution; therefore a real versioned semantic migration, not a harmless metric normalization.
decisions.historical_reporting: Keep the original assertion and record its failure in historical strict regression results. A separate reviewed V6 contract view may assert literal execution and must cite this decision.

reasoning: Active C4 vocabulary resolution explicitly returns alias provenance for sci fi and typo provenance for conservative fuzzy/transposition repairs. These repairs are conditional on the scoped canonical vocabulary, not universal identity claims.
Active C4 calibration requires EXECUTE_WITH_NOTICE whenever corrections or repair_provenance are present. Thus visible notice is already the production policy contract for these successful repairs.

C4 query_repair.compose ends by deciding EXECUTABLE, and explicit mode delegation also defaults to EXECUTABLE. Therefore C4 does not already mandate typed EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE for these SMART cases. The historical typed labels are real C4 compatibility expectations, and this review must not misstate them as nonexistent.

Frozen V5 retains canonical correction provenance and emits typed EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE when notices exist. The frozen regression explicitly requires both typed notice and policy notice for bounded grammar repairs. Making the typed label reflect the existing visible-repair policy is coherent and more informative, provided blocking decisions remain authoritative.

Suppressing correction provenance or silently rewriting repaired inputs merely to reproduce EXECUTABLE would violate the active notice policy. Preserve repaired operands, canonical predicates, original source evidence and visible notice; document the typed migration separately.
boundaries: Canonical exact inputs with no repair evidence may remain EXECUTABLE/AUTO_EXECUTE.
No canonical subject is invented if the scoped vocabulary lacks the target or the conservative resolver cannot uniquely justify it.
INCOMPLETE, AMBIGUOUS, UNSUPPORTED and CONTRADICTORY override notice and remain blocked.
EXACT and explicit literal modes retain their literal semantics; do not apply SMART repair migration globally.
Predicate eligibility is unchanged for the listed successful repairs; the migration changes typed notice classification and retains already-required user-visible policy.
decisions.historical_reporting: Preserve gold-036 and gold-129..132 and C4 reviewed legacy assertions. Report their strict typed mismatches. A separately versioned reviewed contract may project EXECUTABLE_WITH_NOTICE for these entries without editing the original gold.

reasoning: Frozen V5 regression imports bind parse_query/validate to the proof-aware compiler but refine to an older native session module. The older session module imports its own parser, so a refine call can bypass the candidate compiler even when a direct parse uses it.

Native refine edits scalar fields, resets raw_query to the newest short input, emits SESSION_EDIT candidates and calls native decide/validate. Those transformations cannot independently establish that a proof-aware plan's original source/IR and resulting projection agree.

V5's written native contract explicitly identifies conversational refinement and inherited context composition as unintegrated, and requires full resulting-source recompilation and preservation checks for source edits. Its semantics contract rejects SMART plans without IR and invalidates source/projection/digest changes.

Binding only copied candidate regression imports to a new refine adapter is a legitimate way to test the candidate's corresponding interface while keeping old assertions unchanged. It is not proof that legacy production refine or routes are integrated.
required_conditions: Keep original tests, original assertions, original gold and production imports immutable; disclose adapter binding in the candidate test manifest.

The adapter must implement bounded existing continuation/reset/replacement semantics and return the same (plan, continuation) interface; it must not special-case test names, IDs, fixture queries, expected values or benchmark membership.

Compile first turns through the candidate parser; derive subsequent accepted source from explicit permitted edits and preserved previous source/requirements, and recompile the whole accepted source through the candidate compiler.

Preserve source-backed predicates and proof for untouched mandatory requirements, and retain original versus accepted/refined source provenance. Do not treat mutated scalar fields or a synthetic projection as source authority.
Reject stale/forged source, IR, projection or trusted controls; retain blocked typed decisions, capability checks, explicit modes, parser bounds and source evidence.
Measure adapter regressions as engineering component compatibility. Do not count them as validation of production API, session ownership, authorization, durable single use or commit lifecycle.
Record any source-display/raw_query compatibility difference separately; do not silently normalize it away solely to make legacy assertions pass.

conclusion: Both narrowly described semantic migrations are justified by pre-V6 evidence. Keep original strict assertions/gold immutable and report failures honestly; use an explicitly versioned reviewed contract view for migrated expectations. A proof-aware refine import binding is legitimate as an engineering test adapter only under the stated source/proof and reporting conditions. This review does not validate any V6 implementation or production readiness.
